meta.title: ScRoll — tabletop role-playing games from anywhere
meta.description: The TTRPG platform: find campaigns and one-shots, apply to games, chat with your party and play with verified game masters.

hero.subtitle: Find games you'll love, apply in one tap and play TTRPGs from anywhere in the world — with verified game masters and honest ratings.

how.title: From search to first roll — three steps
how.lead: No forum posts, no spreadsheet sign-ups. Everything in one app.

steps.title: Find a game
steps.text: A feed of games with filters by system, genre, format and price. D&D 5e or Cyberpunk RED, one-shot or campaign — with a beginner-friendly badge.
steps.slot: ScRoll app screen: game search filters

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: The master approves — and you're in the party. No seats? The waitlist moves you up automatically, and you see your status in real time.
steps.slot: ScRoll app screen: game page and application

steps.title: Play
steps.text: The party chat is created automatically. Agree on the time — and get to the table, online or in person.

players.title: Find the game that fits
players.lead: Everything you need to get to the table — from search to the post-session review.

cards.title: Feed with filters
cards.text: System, genre, format, price and date. Free-only, beginner-friendly — slice it your way.

cards.title: Applications & waitlist
cards.text: Apply — the master approves — you're in. No seats? The waitlist moves you up automatically.

cards.title: Party chats
cards.text: The game chat is created automatically and runs in real time. Plus private and group chats.

cards.title: Honest ratings
cards.text: 1–5 scores and reviews after every game. Trust is built on real play, not promises.

gameCard.title: Dragon Tower
gameCard.note: a game card — just like in the app

detail.title: See everything before you apply
detail.text: System and format, date and duration, price and open seats — right on the card. Open the master's profile, check the rating and reviews — then decide.

masters.title: Gather your party without the chaos
masters.lead: Audience, organizing tools and reputation — in one place.

cards.title: Publish games
cards.text: Describe your campaign or one-shot, set the format and price. Draft → moderation → live in the feed.

cards.title: Applications under control
cards.text: Approve players, run the waitlist, build the roster. No spreadsheets and no five messengers.

cards.title: Reputation & verification
cards.text: A profile with player ratings and reviews. Platform verification is a mark of quality for new players.

masters.soonText: Game monetization: session payments and prepayment discounts — masters will earn from their campaigns.

trust.title: Cancelled campaigns are not welcome here

items.text: Every game is reviewed before it goes live.
The platform's mark for those you can trust with the table.
Ratings are collected only after played sessions.

community.title: More than game search
community.lead: Events, editorial guides and platform news — right in the app.

cards.title: Talks & meetups
cards.text: Contests, talks and community meetups — with participation and discussions.

cards.title: Guides for beginners
cards.text: How to pick a system, build a character and not fear your first roll.

cards.title: Platform news
cards.text: What's new in ScRoll: features, events and community life.

roadmap.title: The hero's path is already mapped
roadmap.lead: Play, collect reviews and climb the ranks — gamification is in the works.

items.a: Yes. Registration, game search, applications and chats are free. Masters may charge for their games — the price is always visible on the card before you apply.

items.q: How do I become a master?
items.a: Create a game in the app: describe the campaign, set the format and price. After moderation it appears in the feed, and player applications come to you.
Any TTRPG: D&D 5e, Cyberpunk RED and more. The system is shown on the game card and powers the feed filter.
Absolutely. Look for the beginner-friendly badge in the feed and read the guides — they'll help you build your first character and feel at home at the table.
On Google Play. The iOS version is coming later — follow the news in the app and on social media.
